//: Deliberately NOT named `deno.json`: the Supabase CLI auto-discovers that name when
bundling functions, and this file exists only for CI type-checking. Deployment
behaviour must not depend on it.
nodeModulesDir=none keeps Deno from trying to resolve `npm:` specifiers out of the
repo's Node `node_modules/` (which is for the Vite app, not the functions).
The Edge Runtime resolves them from the registry the same way.
